verdict.rationale: First-party support docs say llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, and it runs on macOS across most CPU architectures, which covers the core of Metal-accelerated inference on Apple Silicon. The evidence is a single thin line, though, and ARM-specific CPU optimization is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of native ARM/Apple Silicon optimizations, Metal setup or configuration details, Apple Silicon performance benchmarks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Metal acceleration on Macs.
